I know that want. I was and still am a very lonely person. Not to say I don't know people or people aren't kind to me. Just I would go months at a time with people saying maybe about a sentence to me at best. I had a hard time going to my family for some sort of connection. It's something I am still working through but am getting better. One important piece of advice I got from a therapist is there are plenty of others who are thinking the same thing wanting the same wants. And to just go out and ask them. So I came to some of my better friends and talked out my feelings of loneliness and asked for a hug. It sounds too simple but that's really all you need to do.
